prompts.title: Golden Hour Drive
prompts.prompt:
Create a cinematic, ultra-realistic lifestyle portrait of a couple enjoying a relaxed drive in a classic open-top convertible during golden hour. The camera is positioned at eye level from the front woman's side, capturing both subjects in a natural medium-wide portrait orientation inside the car.
The man sits confidently in the driver's seat, driving the car with one hand resting casually on the steering wheel. He wears a beige and cream vertically striped button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearms, the top buttons slightly open, tailored camel trousers, and a classic brown leather-strap wristwatch. He has neatly black hair, and a calm, affectionate expression while looking toward the woman.
The woman is seated comfortably in the front passenger seat with leg folded naturally. She wears a taupe pinstriped cropped jacket featuring an asymmetrical lapel with a decorative gold button, layered over a soft beige knit top, paired with relaxed cream wide-leg trousers and brown leather loafers. Her medium-length wavy hair is loosely tied back with a large beige ribbon, with soft face-framing strands. She smiles warmly while making eye contact with the man, creating a candid romantic moment.
The convertible features a black leather interior, visible seat belts, and a clean minimalist dashboard. The roof is folded down, allowing warm natural sunlight to illuminate both subjects.
The background shows a quiet suburban street lined with lush green trees, boundary walls, utility poles. Apply gentle motion blur to the roadside and background to enhance the feeling of movement while keeping the couple perfectly sharp and in focus.
The lighting is soft golden-hour sunlight with warm highlights, natural skin tones, subtle shadows, and cinematic color grading. Use shallow depth of field with smooth background separation while preserving enough environmental detail for realism.

prompts.title: The Monochrome Gentleman
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for the subject’s face and identity reference. Preserve the person’s natural facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, and overall likeness with high accuracy.
Create an ultra-realistic black-and-white luxury studio portrait in a vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.
Show the subject in a waist-up portrait, standing against a deep black seamless studio background with only a very subtle soft charcoal glow behind the head for separation.
The subject should look calm, confident, and introspective, with closed lips, relaxed facial muscles, and direct eye contact. Keep the pose natural and elegant.

Composition and pose
Keep the subject centered but not perfectly symmetrical
The body should have a slight natural asymmetry, with a subtle relaxed shift instead of a stiff straight-on stance
The body and head should be slightly tilted naturally toward the camera
Use a slightly low camera angle
Leave comfortable negative space above the head
Keep the portrait tight and powerful, not zoomed out like a full-body fashion shot

Hand pose
One hand should rest near the lower chest/lapel area, with fingers naturally curved
The other hand should be placed lower, holding or adjusting the opposite wrist/cuff
The hands should form a compact crossed-wrist composition

A premium dark chronograph wristwatch must be clearly visible and naturally integrated into the pose

Outfit
Dress the subject in a tailored black formal suit, white dress shirt, slim black tie, and a small neat white pocket square. Keep the suit refined, elegant, and realistic, with subtle fabric texture and natural folds.

Lighting
Use dramatic chiaroscuro lighting:
a soft but strong key light from the upper camera-left
the lit side of the face, collar, lapel, and upper hand should be clearly sculpted
The opposite side should fall into deep, soft shadow
keep a strong contrast with smooth tonal falloff
Add subtle catchlights in the eyes
lighting should feel cinematic, moody, and editorial, not flat or evenly lit

Style and quality
Rich monochrome black-and-white grading
Deep blacks, soft silver-gray highlights, and smooth contrast
Clean luxury editorial finish
Serious, masculine, elegant mood
Natural skin texture, realistic hands, detailed suit fabric
85mm portrait lens look, shallow depth of field, magazine-quality realism

Avoid
No smile, no teeth, no stiff symmetrical body pose, no straight upright head, no flat lighting, no bright gray background, no busy backdrop, no extra accessories, and no generic corporate headshot feel.

prompts.title: Old-school Charm
prompts.prompt:
Create a 4:5 aspect ratio, high-resolution, hyper-realistic studio portrait of a stylish man with a sophisticated, confident gentleman aesthetic. Use the provided reference image for strict facial identity matching — preserve facial structure, proportions, skin tone, age characteristics, beard density, hairstyle, and natural facial details without beautification or stylization.
If the reference shows a clean-shaven face, the subject must remain completely clean-shaven — do not add, enhance, suggest, or stylize any beard or stubble. If facial hair is present in the reference image, it must be preserved accurately and appear natural, clean, and well-groomed.
The subject is shown in a waist-up medium shot, centered in frame, making direct eye contact with a subtle, confident smirk. His left hand is raised naturally while tipping or adjusting a classic black fedora, while his right hand rests inside his trouser pocket, creating a relaxed yet composed posture. Body posture remains upright and balanced, conveying calm confidence and elegance.
Clothing & Accessories:

The subject wears a well-tailored chocolate-brown blazer with classic notch lapels, flap pockets, and visible textile weave, buttoned at the top for a structured silhouette. Underneath is a dark charcoal or black open-collar button-down shirt with no tie, creating a modern vintage smart-casual look. A matte black fedora with a grosgrain ribbon sits naturally on the head. On the left wrist, a gold-tone luxury watch with a metallic link bracelet and large circular dial adds a refined accent.
Physical Detail & Realism:

Maintain natural skin texture, visible pores, subtle laugh lines, and realistic beard(if present) texture with slight salt-and-pepper tones. Eyes remain natural and sharp, with realistic light reflections.
Lighting & Technical Style:

Soft cinematic studio lighting with the key light coming from the upper left, creating gentle shadows and a subtle Rembrandt-style triangle of light on the opposite cheek. Soft shadowing appears beneath the hat brim, adding depth and dimension. Shallow depth of field keeps the subject sharply focused against a smooth background.
Background & Color Palette:

A warm, smooth studio backdrop in muted tan and brown tones with a soft vignette — lighter behind the subject’s head and darker toward the edges for separation. Overall color grading uses warm earthy tones such as umber, sienna, and ochre, balanced by the contrast of the black hat and shirt.
Negative prompts:

over-smoothing, plastic skin, exaggerated sharpness, identity change, cartoonish rendering, unrealistic lighting, distorted hands, extra fingers, blurred face, over-stylization, heavy HDR, artificial skin glow.
